name: Fish Battles
summary:
🎮 Fish Battles – VR Battle Royale in the Deep! 🐠🚀

Dive into the ultimate underwater battle royale, built exclusively for VR!
Whether you're in it for laughs or aiming for the crown, Fish Battles brings fast-paced, fin-slapping action to life.

No internet connection required.
– Choose your map, pick a specie, and fight to level up.

🧬 Choose Your Species

22 unique sea creatures (not just fish!) to master, including:

- 🦭 Sea Lion

- 🦈 White Shark

- 🐢 Green Turtle

- 🐠 Peacock Grouper

- 🛸 Stingr
